body: An easyJet Airbus A320-200, registration G-EZUZ, performing flight U2-213 from Bristol to Edinburgh, was climbing out of Bristol's runway 27 on November 18 when the aircraft suffered a bird strike. The crew stopped the climb at FL150 and returned to Bristol for a safe landing on runway 27 about 40 minutes after departure. The airline reported a bird strike, and a ground observer reported the aircraft emitted an unusual noise from the engines during the climb out of runway 27. A replacement A320-200, registration G-EZWL, reached Edinburgh with a delay of about 2.5 hours, while the occurrence aircraft was still on the ground in Bristol about 6.5 hours after landing.

A PSA Airlines Bombardier CRJ-900, registration N566NN, operating for American Airlines as flight AA-5206 from Baton Rouge to Washington National, was on approach to Washington on November 17 when the crew reported a problem with the unsafe nose gear. The aircraft continued the approach to runway 01, and on short final the tower reported the main gear was down and added that the nose gear was down, too. The aircraft landed safely and taxied to the apron. The FAA reported: "American Eagle Flight 5206 landed safely at Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport after the pilot reported a nose gear issue." The FAA is investigating the incident, which occurred around 9:45 a.m. local time on Tuesday, November 17.

An IndiGo Airbus A321-200N, registration VT-IBB, performing flight 6E-388 from Mangaluru to Bangalore with 236 people on board, was accelerating for takeoff from Mangaluru's runway 24 on November 16 when the crew rejected takeoff at high speed, about 135 knots over ground, after the left hand LEAP engine emitted a number of bangs and streaks of flame. The aircraft slowed safely and stopped on the runway for about 10 minutes before returning to the apron. The airline reported a technical problem occurred shortly before takeoff. A replacement A321-200N, registration VT-ILJ, reached Bangalore with a delay of about 4:50 hours, while the occurrence aircraft was still on the ground in Mangaluru about 27 hours after the rejected takeoff.

An American Airlines Boeing 737-800, registration N924NN, performing flight AA-496 from Tampa to Washington National with 178 people on board, was climbing out of Tampa's runway 01L on November 16 when the crew reported a left hand CFM56 engine indication and wanted to level off at 10,000 feet. After working the checklists the crew decided to shut the engine down. The crew initially intended to return to Tampa but then decided to divert to Orlando, landing on Orlando's runway 36L about 45 minutes after departure. A replacement Boeing 737-800, registration N917NN, reached Washington with a delay of about 2 hours, while the occurrence aircraft was still on the ground in Orlando about 21 hours after landing.
en.summary: Four aviation incidents reported between November 16 and 18, 2026: an easyJet A320 returned to Bristol after a bird strike, an American Eagle CRJ-900 landed safely at Washington National with a nose gear problem, an IndiGo A321neo rejected takeoff at high speed, and an American Airlines 737-800 diverted to Orlando after shutting down an engine. All four aircraft landed safely.
en.title: Four aviation incidents in one roundup: easyJet bird strike, American Eagle nose gear scare and more

facts.claim: An easyJet Airbus A320-200, registration G-EZUZ, on flight U2-213 from Bristol to Edinburgh, suffered a bird strike climbing out of runway 27, stopped the climb at FL150 and returned to Bristol, landing safely on runway 27 about 40 minutes after departure; the replacement A320-200 G-EZWL reached Edinburgh about 2.5 hours late, and the occurrence aircraft was still on the ground in Bristol about 6.5 hours after landing.

A PSA Airlines Bombardier CRJ-900, registration N566NN, on flight AA-5206 from Baton Rouge to Washington National, reported an unsafe nose gear problem on approach; the tower confirmed on short final that the main gear and the nose gear were down, and the aircraft landed safely on runway 01 and taxied to the apron; the FAA is investigating the incident, which occurred around 9:45 a.m. local time on November 17.

An IndiGo Airbus A321-200N, registration VT-IBB, on flight 6E-388 from Mangaluru to Bangalore with 236 people on board, rejected takeoff at about 135 knots over ground after the left hand LEAP engine emitted bangs and streaks of flame; the aircraft stopped on the runway for about 10 minutes before returning to the apron, and the replacement A321-200N VT-ILJ reached Bangalore about 4:50 hours late.

An American Airlines Boeing 737-800, registration N924NN, on flight AA-496 from Tampa to Washington National with 178 people on board, reported a left hand CFM56 engine indication climbing out of runway 01L, levelled off at 10,000 feet, shut the engine down and diverted to Orlando, landing on runway 36L about 45 minutes after departure; the replacement 737-800 N917NN reached Washington about 2 hours late.

body: 易捷航空一架空中巴士A320-200（註冊編號G-EZUZ）執行U2-213航班由布里斯托飛往愛丁堡，11月18日由布里斯托27號跑道爬升時遭遇鳥擊，機組停止爬升於FL150並返回布里斯托，約40分鐘後安全降落於27號跑道。航空公司回報為鳥擊，地面目擊者表示飛機由27號跑道爬升時發動機傳出異常噪音。替代機A320-200（註冊編號G-EZWL）延誤約2.5小時抵達愛丁堡，事發飛機在降落約6.5小時後仍停在布里斯托。
美國航空旗下PSA航空一架龐巴迪CRJ-900（註冊編號N566NN）執行AA-5206航班由巴頓魯治飛往華盛頓國家機場，11月17日進場時機組回報前起落架不安全指示，飛機繼續進場至01跑道，塔台在最後進場階段確認主起落架與前起落架均已放下，飛機安全降落後滑行至停機坪。美國聯邦航空總署表示，事件發生於當地時間11月17日上午約9時45分，正在調查中。

IndiGo一架空中巴士A321-200N（註冊編號VT-IBB）執行6E-388航班由門格洛爾飛往班加羅爾，機上共236人，11月16日由門格洛爾24號跑道加速起飛時，左側LEAP發動機傳出數聲巨響並噴出火焰，機組在高速（地面速度約135節）中斷起飛，飛機安全減速並在跑道上停留約10分鐘後返回停機坪。航空公司表示起飛前不久發生技術問題。替代機A321-200N（註冊編號VT-ILJ）延誤約4小時50分抵達班加羅爾，事發飛機在中斷起飛約27小時後仍停在門格洛爾。

美國航空一架波音737-800（註冊編號N924NN）執行AA-496航班由坦帕飛往華盛頓國家機場，機上共178人，11月16日由坦帕01L跑道爬升時，機組回報左側CFM56發動機出現異常指示，要求在1萬英尺平飛，完成檢查單後決定關閉該發動機。機組原擬返回坦帕，隨後決定轉降奧蘭多，約45分鐘後降落於奧蘭多36L跑道。替代機737-800（註冊編號N917NN）延誤約2小時抵達華盛頓，事發飛機在降落約21小時後仍停在奧蘭多。
zh.summary: 2026年11月16日至18日通報4起飛安事件：易捷航空A320鳥擊返航布里斯托、美鷹航空CRJ-900前起落架異常安全降落華盛頓、IndiGo A321neo高速中斷起飛、美國航空737-800單發失效轉降奧蘭多，4架飛機皆安全降落。
zh.title: 飛安彙整：易捷航空A320鳥擊返航、美鷹航空CRJ-900前起落架異常等4起事件
